Dialogs.Dialog: Look. I got my hair cut. What do you think？
So you cut it short, huh.
Look. I cut my hair. Any thoughts？
Look. I tried cutting my hair short. Does it suit me？
Say... What do you think of this length？
Hey, I tried changing my hair length. What do you think？
Oh, so it's medium length now...
Hey. This hair length doesn't look weird, right？
My hair's gotten pretty long. What do you think？
Say, my hair's grown out quite a bit, huh. Does it suit me？
Hey. I grew my hair out, but... it doesn't look weird, does it？
It's gotten really long, hasn't it...
I see. So you like it. I figured as much, though.
I see, I see. So you like it？ I knew you'd say that, though.
Hehe. I knew you'd say that. Thanks.
Huh？ And here I thought you liked this sort of thing...
What, so you don't like it？ Oh...
And here I thought you'd like it... Sigh...
I tried styling my hair a bit differently.
I liked how it was before...
Take a look. It's a new version of my hairstyle.
Hey, I tried doing something different with my hair. Does it suit me？
Good to hear. Maybe I'll make this one of my regulars.
Oh, yeah？ So you do like it？ Just like I thought.
Aw, come on. I thought it looked cute...
I changed my hair color. What do you think？
Look. I changed my hair color.
Yeah, it's a whole new vibe...
Hey. Do you think this hair color suits me？
It suits you. I like it.
I thought a change of pace might be nice... so I went with this color.
Total change in vibe, right？ What do you think？
Forget the vibe, it's a no.
I thought this color might feel fresh. Is it bad？
I was thinking of changing up my style a little...
My outfit has a different vibe today, don't you think？
Here, how do you like this look on me？ I think it's a different vibe from usual.
I tried going for a neat and proper look... How is it？
How's this look？ Pretty modest, right？
I was going for a neat, proper look. What do you think？
Dressing all girly like this is kind of embarrassing, though...
I know I'm saying it myself, but these clothes are cute, right？
I went for a cute look today. Do you like it？
Casual styles like this are surprisingly tricky. What do you think？
Hey. What do you think of me in a casual look？
Not what I was hoping for...
I tried going for a more mature look... Is it weird？
I wanted to look a little more grown-up... How is it？
Think this gives me a little sex appeal...? Or no good？
Really？ Then maybe I'll stick with clothes like this from now on.
If you like it, I'll keep dressing along these lines for you.
Good to hear. Maybe I'll keep going with this look from now on♪
What's with that...? If you don't like it, then forget it.
You don't have to put it like that... Idiot!
What...? And here I thought you'd like this kind of thing.
Sigh... Give me a clearer reaction than that.
Oh... And here I thought you'd be happier about it.
So you're not interested in me...
So, any thoughts on today's outfit？ I think it's pretty modest, though.
Well, let's hear your thoughts again today？ Just for the record.
Why not try a new look？
I went with a neat, modest look again today. How is it？
With cute clothes like this, I always worry if they actually suit me...
Doesn't today's outfit feel really girly？
Hey, how about this look for today？
Why not try a new look？
Is it okay if I keep dressing like this？ Stuff like this is comfortable.
Are the clothes I'm wearing now your type？ This laid-back style, I mean.
My outfit right now isn't weird, is it？ I think it's a pretty casual look.
I see. Well, in that case, I guess it's fine.
Right？ I knew you'd say that.
Thank goodness. I like getting compliments. Hehe.
Oh, really. So you like something else. You should've said so sooner.
What's with the high-and-mighty attitude？ Well, fine, I get it.
I see... Next time I'll wear something you'll compliment me on.
Give me a straight answer. The whole point is whether it's good or bad.
Geez. Don't you have more to say than that？
